description: House Speaker Laurie Jinkins told reporters Thursday that Washington lawmakers are working to pass a wealth tax after all. The Tacoma Democrat’s comment comes weeks after Gov. title: WA Democrats bring back wealth tax idea with ‘limited dollar amount’ — Noel Frame: Democrat for State Senate - 36th LD
